note: Round-2 hypotheses are NEW ids (H13+). H01–H12 are never modified. Thresholds fixed a-priori; no parameter search.

H20_CTRL_RANGE_BREAKOUT_RETEST.why: explicit control; mechanism+params identical to H02_5M_RANGE_BREAKOUT

hypotheses.hypothesis: a range breakout only continues when the execution environment is favourable
hypotheses.mechanism: execution-regime gate: the same price pattern has different payoff when spreads are tight and quote churn is normal; round 1 tested the pattern, never the gate
hypotheses.invalid_condition: close back inside range within hold
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: execution-environment GATE as the primary mechanism; H02 traded the breakout unconditionally

hypotheses.hypothesis: after a tick-rate collapse (z < -2) the next bar reverts
hypotheses.mechanism: liquidity vacuum: when quote churn collapses, the last printed move is unrepresentative and refills
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: uses tick-rate COLLAPSE; H11 used tick-rate SPIKE

hypotheses.hypothesis: a low-vol -> expansion transition continues in the expansion direction for 8 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: volatility state transition: compression resolves into a directional leg; the entry is the STATE CHANGE, not a level test
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: entry condition is a state TRANSITION (compression->expansion). H01/H04 fade WITHIN a vol state; H08 used Bollinger levels

hypotheses.hypothesis: after a volatility climax the market quiets and mean-reverts for 8 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: post-climax exhaustion: a vol spike consumes inventory; the follow-through is a quiet reversion
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: high-vol CLIMAX regime; round 1 never conditioned on the top vol decile

hypotheses.hypothesis: the London leg continues for 6 bars after the 13:00 UTC handoff
hypotheses.mechanism: session handoff: NY desks inherit London positioning; the inherited leg persists briefly
hypotheses.invalid_condition: leg reverses on the handoff bar
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: handoff continuation of a PRIOR session leg; H03 only used the first bar of its own session

hypotheses.hypothesis: an Asia-range extreme broken during London and reclaimed fades for 6 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: stop-run then reclaim: trapped breakout traders provide the fuel for the fade
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: cross-session fake-break (Asia range vs London break); round 1 had only a rolling 20-bar range in H02

hypotheses.hypothesis: short-horizon momentum is only net-positive when realised spread is below the cost anchor
hypotheses.mechanism: cost-aware execution gate: the sign of the gross edge is stable but its net sign flips with the cost level, so the gate is the tradable content
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: gates on the COST LEVEL itself rather than on price/vol structure

hypotheses.hypothesis: (CONTROL) a close beyond the prior 20-bar high continues 10 bars
hypotheses.novelty_reason: CONTROL: intentionally reproduces H02 to exercise REJECT_DUPLICATE_HYPOTHESIS

hypotheses.hypothesis: a Gold/DXY/UST10Y/VIX state combination precedes a repeatable gold move
hypotheses.mechanism: cross-asset disagreement indicates flow-driven rather than macro-driven pricing
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: cross-asset state combination (no price-only analogue)

hypotheses.hypothesis: after a macro release the repricing window is tradable for 6 bars
hypotheses.mechanism: information diffusion: prices reprice in stages after a release

hypotheses.hypothesis: a narrative shift (LLM-classified) precedes a repeatable gold move
hypotheses.novelty_reason: NEW: narrative-based (research evidence, not a trading signal)
